failures.detail: Bun isolated workspace links expose multiple filesystem installations of the same versions. The deterministic native-config gate resolves 22 unique Expo packages and 23 unique Apple pods, and Podfile.lock resolves one source for each inspected native module. Doctor therefore identifies package-layout risk, not proof of duplicate native code in this binary; a clean EAS/Xcode archive remains the hard native-build gate.

failures.check: app config fields may not sync in a non-CNG project
failures.detail: Because ios/ is checked in, app.json changes require explicit native-project synchronization or a controlled prebuild. The mobile test command now runs Expo introspection and fails when checked-in permission/version metadata drifts.

reviewItems.finding: Marketing-version metadata is aligned; the production build number is intentionally owned by remote EAS versioning and must be verified in the archive.
reviewItems.recommendation: Keep the local parity gate passing, and assert the remotely managed CFBundleVersion is monotonically increasing in the signed production archive.

reviewItems.finding: Production APNs entitlement correctness can only be proven from the codesigned archive.
reviewItems.evidence: Expo SDK 57 intentionally generates aps-environment=development in source; Xcode derives production for a distribution archive from the provisioning profile.
reviewItems.recommendation: Preserve the generated development source value, then inspect the codesigned production archive and require aps-environment=production before App Store delivery.

reviewItems.finding: Expo Updates is intentionally disabled for store-only binary releases.
reviewItems.evidence: EXUpdatesEnabled=false, expo-updates is absent, and no runtime version or update channels are configured.
reviewItems.recommendation: Keep this policy unless OTA updates are deliberately adopted with explicit runtime-version compatibility and channel testing.

reviewItems.finding: Native production archive size, launch time, dSYM, and signed entitlements could not be measured on this machine.
reviewItems.evidence: xcode-select points to /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools and no /Applications/Xcode*.app is installed
reviewItems.recommendation: Add an EAS/macOS CI archive job that records IPA/app bytes, app-thinning report, launch metric, dSYM presence, and codesigned entitlements.

nativeBranding.runtimeExportAccounting: The icon and splash are native resources. They are not among the 23 Metro runtime assets and are intentionally outside the JavaScript export budget.

bundleTopology.detail: Expo Router native production exports are a single Hermes bytecode bundle. Route files remain synchronous in that HBC; Hermes memory mapping mitigates load cost, while the total-bundle gate prevents dependency regressions.

removed.reason: No remaining direct imports; Expo SDK 56+ app code should consume navigation exports through expo-router, and the source-map A/B proved the external package closure was removed.

retained.reason: They remain in Expo Router's production navigation/transition closure; removal was not assumed safe.
The app ships no custom font files, but Expo and expo-symbols retain expo-font transitively, so removing only the direct declaration/plugin was not shown to reduce the native graph.
